newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Brazil parallel bond issue poised for next week - CA.
newsitem.headline: Brazil parallel bond issue poised for next week - CA.

text.p: Brazil plans a $570 million parallel bond issue next week in France, the Netherlands and Austria, co-lead manager Creditanstalt-Bankverein said on Wednesday.

The parallel bond, the first of its kind for an emerging market issuer, will have a five-year maturity and comes in three tranches denominated in French francs, Dutch guilders and Austrian schillings.
All tranches will carry the same coupon and be fungible, or redenominated to the euro after the single European currency is introduced in 1999.
The coupon would be determined at issue, while the benchmark would be the Brazilian 8.875 percent bond due in 2001, issued last November.
The yield at issue of the last Brazilian bond stood 183 basis points over the yield of an Austrian bond, Creditanstalt said.
The other lead managers are ING Barings and Paribas.
Brazil will issue $170 million worth in Austria, and $200 million each in the Netherlands and France.
